I found the issue! Looking at the frai-gate CLI (line 87), it checks for the `ci` flag using `args.flags.has('ci')`. The problem is in the frai CLI's gate command handler (line 753 in index.ts) — the `--ci` flag is being consumed by the main program's option parser (defined on line 605) and isn't being passed through to frai-gate in the `args`.

When you run `frai gate init --ci`, Commander.js parses `--ci` as a global option before the gate subcommand even receives its arguments, so the gate handler only gets `['init']` without the `--ci` flag.

The fix is to check if `--ci` was passed on the command-line and include it when spawning frai-gate:
